details:
I’d like to share my thoughts on the social features in this beta version, along with some suggestions for improvement.

First, I’ll discuss the changes made to the “Nameplate,” “User Page,” and “Social Page” in the menu.

Let’s start with the “Nameplate.”

This design is quite different from previous versions. I’d like to point out two main issues: “It’s hard to tell if someone is a friend” and “You can’t tell which platform the user is on.”

In particular, not knowing the platform makes it difficult to handle avatars or worlds that aren’t supported on that platform.

A minor issue is that “even if you’re not in VRC+, the avatar thumbnail is used as an icon.” While there’s nothing inherently wrong with this, I feel it slightly diminishes the advantage VRC+ users have.

As suggestions for improvement, I’d like to propose “changing the friend’s name text back to yellow,” “displaying at least the platform icon,” and “allowing VRC+ users to display other special icons.”

Next, I’d like to summarize my thoughts on the “User Page” and the “Social Page” in the menu.

Since the methods for changing these and their specifications are similar, I’ll cover them together.

I suspect these changes were made with the goal of integrating them with the web page, but this has led to a problem: “the button locations are hard to find.”

Previously, the buttons were large and easy to understand, with illustrations and descriptions of their functions, but with this update, they’ve become smaller and harder to identify.

In particular, I feel that separate buttons should be provided for moderation-related actions to make them especially clear.

Also, although it’s a minor issue, “you can no longer view avatar details from the user page”—though this is just something I personally found inconvenient, so others might not feel the same way.

My suggestion for improvement is a rather obvious one: “Make the buttons larger and add clear icons.” However, I believe a significant number of users will struggle with the interface unless this is addressed. In fact, I have many friends who are having this issue, so I think usability should be a priority.

These are my thoughts on the recent changes and my suggestions for improvement.

I believe that implementing even just one of these suggestions would make the experience much more comfortable.
title: [1878]Thoughts on Social Media Displays and a Review of Them
